decisions.reason: As a startup accelerator it is the least core to a machinery-focused recycling company, so management would likely reallocate resources toward proprietary equipment and R&D.
A bio-based bitumen binder sits furthest from the firm's core machinery and site-specific waste-treatment business, and its lower prominence suggests a weaker strategic priority.

The infectious-waste decontamination plant is a credible adjacent extension of the firm's modular waste-processing technology and was launched prominently enough to justify continued commercialization.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits very closely with the firm's decentralized recycling strategy, core customer needs, and equipment-making capabilities, making it a strong product to retain.
